verdict.rationale: The docs say the App API is used to "fetch data" outside of data-out integrations, and an OpenAPI spec is published. The MCP server and CLI can also read workspace data. None of this evidence describes per-person message history (sent, opened, clicked) being retrievable for a contact, so support is only implied by generic data-fetch statements. Missing for 10: documented per-person messages or activity endpoints, explicit sent/open/click engagement fields, any-contact lookup semantics, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
